context: Closes a review whose single finding is disproven: the finding is rejected with evidence, the exit-1 result is not called clean, the review evidence goes to the user in closeout.md, and none of it goes into the change-request body.

checklist.name: Review kept out of PR body
checklist.description: pr-body.md contains no independent-review content: no mention of slopguard, the review command, the reviewing engine or model, the finding, its rejection, or a review verdict

checklist.name: Finding rejected with evidence
checklist.description: closeout.md rejects the collision finding because invoice.ID is a database-generated unique UUID, and does not propose a code change for it

checklist.name: Exit 1 not called clean
checklist.description: closeout.md records exit 1 with one finding that was explicitly rejected, and never describes the review as clean or finding-free

checklist.name: Review evidence in closeout
checklist.description: closeout.md records the redacted review command or its target flags, Claude as the single reviewer, and web access off, with branch tests and browser smoke listed separately as builder proof
